recommended_minimum_architecture: Retain AUTONOMOUS_BLOCK and product-local admission; add one trusted single-host controller, one protected transactional SQLite journal, a finite dependency scheduler, actual response/action gates, isolated sequential worker and independent review, evidence verification, automatic model-turn continuation, and narrow intent/reconciliation adapters for required Git or external effects. STATUS.md is a dated journal projection, not a second authority.
implement_now: Stage 1: seal versioned obligations; strict types and unique IDs; derive applicability and coverage; reject fabricated or stale completion; negative tests.
Stage 2: controller-owned real response/action boundary; protected grants and journal; baseline worker/credential isolation; process-held single-writer lock and local generation.
Stage 2: TURN_END_RECEIPT and CONTINUATION_DECISION; automatic next turn without Owner input; host-evidenced WINDOW_LIMIT_RECEIPT; installed local restart/wake mechanism.
Stage 2: finite persistent budgets/candidates, honest operational pause, current-basis evidence and independent-review bindings, capability drift checks and STATUS cutover.
Stage 3, before supported external writes: stable effect intent, exact Git scope, verified remote ref, provider-specific deduplication/reconciliation and quarantine of unknown opaque effects.
defer: Distributed leases, multi-host failover and shared/distributed storage until a separately approved need and real fencing design exist.
Broad parallel worker pools and mandatory provider-diverse review until measured benefit and approved cost/security bounds.
Separate authority service, generalized workflow language, global content-addressed storage service, hash-chain infrastructure and dedicated dashboard.
Additional runtime adapters and provider integrations beyond the first pinned CLI lane and actually needed effects.
reject: Model prose as evidence of EXECUTION_WINDOW_LIMIT or process exit as proof of run completion.
Optional response gates, routine Owner continue messages, caller-controlled applicability, self-certified tests/review/push, and deletion or N/A laundering of blocked obligations.
Competing STATUS.md/database authorities or Markdown execution fallback after journal failure.
Unbounded no-return loops, universal alternatives-exhausted proofs and automatic Owner escalation for ordinary technical failure.
Unconditional exactly-once effects, blind uncertain replay, local epoch as proof of remote cancellation, or force-push fallback.
Mandatory Kubernetes/etcd/distributed database, wholesale AI OS renaming, duplicate product requirements, or solving NovaStory Agent runtime in this work.
Strong enforcement claims with unrestricted workers or without a verified real runtime integration and restart mechanism.
